privacy: <section><heading>Pseudonymization and queued calculations</heading><paragraph>HMAC binding values and stable browser identifiers associate accounts or events. They are pseudonymization measures, not complete anonymization. Information that can be linked to a person remains protected under this policy.</paragraph><paragraph>Submitting a calculation sends necessary inputs, including the Operator Box, layout and rotation settings, to the site’s server and solver. When the asynchronous queue is enabled, encrypted task inputs are temporarily stored in the business database for execution, separately from optional long-term workspace synchronization. Task records expire <number>24</number> hours after creation; terminal-state handling clears encrypted inputs, and subsequent cleanup removes expired records. Calculation records and voluntarily submitted feedback snapshots follow the retention periods in this policy and exclude Skland credentials and full status snapshots.</paragraph></section><section><heading>Public skill notes and administrator actions</heading><paragraph>Skill clarifications published by administrators appear publicly on the corresponding skill pages and are stored independently from automatically updated game assets until edited, deleted or otherwise handled under law. Do not include personal information or credentials in notes.</paragraph><paragraph>For content management, the site stores operator and skill identifiers, note text, creation and update times, and the website user identifiers of the creating and last-editing administrators. Public note responses exclude administrator user identifiers. Deleting an administrator account removes those user associations but does not automatically delete published notes.</paragraph></section><section><heading>Private contact and personal-information requests</heading><paragraph>Use the email listed on this page, if available, or a private message to the <officialAccount>site’s official Bilibili account</officialAccount> to request access, a copy, correction, deletion, withdrawal of consent or other rights under applicable law. Start with a brief description; do not post credentials, passwords, email-verification information or identity documents in public issues or comments.</paragraph><paragraph>Contact through Bilibili uses that platform’s services and is subject to its own rules and privacy policy. The site may process necessary account-association information to verify a request, but will not ask for passwords or Skland login credentials. Where a request cannot be fulfilled, the site will explain the reason as required by law.</paragraph><paragraph>Withdrawing optional cloud-sync consent does not disable experience analytics, which currently run automatically as described above. Clearing the browser identifier does not automatically delete events already received by the server or permanently opt out of analytics.</paragraph></section><section><heading>Children’s personal information</heading><paragraph>Personal information of children under fourteen is sensitive personal information under applicable Chinese law. A parent or other guardian should read this policy and provide legally required consent before a child uses features that submit or synchronize personal information. Do not submit such information without that consent. Guardians may use the private contact channels in this policy to request access, correction or deletion. If processing without required guardian consent is discovered, the site will investigate and take legally required measures, including deletion where appropriate.</paragraph></section>
